thread:
tara: FYI I opened a tiny docs PR for the Astrum-8B model card. Two quick things I found while drafting: 1) the CLI example uses `rw model set-limit` (old) and 2) the Python example in examples/astrum uses `model_id=` param.

alfred: Thanks. We deprecated `rw model` singular last quarter in favor of `rw models` (plural). Proposed CLI replacement: 
```bash
# update token limit for astrum-8b
rw models limits update --model astrum-8b --max-tokens 8192
```

ben: Note: the limits table also lists "max_seq: 8k" but our bench shows the recommended soft limit is 6k with default kv-cache. We should add a short note under "practical limits" explaining the difference and recommend `--max-tokens` values per deployment type.

tara: Good point. I'll change the table row to 6000 and add a parenthetical: (8k theoretical, 6k recommended with default KV cache).

luisa: On the SDK side: current Python snippet uses `client.generate(model_id="astrum-8b", prompt=prompt)`. The new SDK expects `model` not `model_id`, and the client method is now `client.text.generate(...)` per SDK v2. I'll push a fix with an updated snippet: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.text.generate(model="astrum-8b", input=prompt)
print(resp.output_text)
```

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed - linkcheck error: /docs/catalog/astrum-8b#benchmarks -> 404 (source file links to s3://redwood-docs/bench/astrum/v1/report.html)

ben: That S3 path changed when we migrated reports. New path is s3://redwood-docs/bench/astrum/v2/report.html. I'll update the URL in the PR.

alfred: Also please add a short compatibility note: quantized CPU fallback was unintentionally listed as supported for astrum-8b; per infra team quant profiles, quantized CPU requires 16GB+ and we only guarantee GPU quant on inference nodes. Suggest wording: "quantized: GPU supported; CPU quant may work on large instances but is not supported."

tara: Adding that note now. Also adding a one-line changelog entry: "docs: astrum-8b card - update limits, CLI & SDK snippets, fix bench link" so users scanning releases see it.

luisa: Quick ask: can someone sanity-check the sample output in the SDK example? We convert to `resp.output_text` now, older code used `resp[0].text`. I updated the example accordingly but want a second pair of eyes.

ben: LGTM. The preview deploy will show if the sample renders correctly.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. docs preview: https://deploy-preview-1371--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/astrum-8b

alfred: Preview looks clean. The benchmarks anchor resolves and the CLI code block has the right flags.

tara: Merging in 10 if no objections. Thanks everyone for quick turn.

luisa: :thumbsup: One follow-up: I'll open a tiny migration note in the SDK docs listing `model_id -> model` and `client.generate -> client.text.generate`. Link it from the Astrum card under "SDK examples".

tara: Perfect. If anyone spots flaky numbers in bench table after the infra rerun, comment on the merged PR and we'll follow up with a bench-recalc.
